PROJECT 01

SmartSprout Automated Irrigation

Embedded SoftwareSensorsIoT / MQTTSystem Architecture

SmartSprout is an automated irrigation system designed to monitor environmental conditions and support watering decisions using sensor data. My primary contribution was writing the project's software, connecting sensor measurements, communication, and irrigation behavior.

Individual contribution

  • Wrote the project's software, connecting sensor inputs to monitoring and control logic.
  • Implemented processing and handling of environmental measurements used by the system.
  • Developed MQTT communication logic for transmitting measurements over the network.
  • Implemented irrigation decision logic based on configured soil-moisture conditions and watering behavior.
PROJECT 02

Autonomous Boat

CAD PrototypingPhysical IntegrationIterative Design

This project involved developing an autonomous boat capable of navigating a course. I wrote all of the project's code, including the navigation software, and contributed to the electrical circuit and initial hull design.

Individual contribution

  • Wrote the project's code, including navigation behavior used to guide the boat around the course.
  • Helped design the initial hull and contributed to physical prototyping.
  • Assisted with the physical electrical circuit and hardware integration.
  • The boat completed three laps in approximately 4 minutes and 50 seconds.
PROJECT 03

Audio Amplifier and Filter Circuit

Analog ElectronicsMATLAB / SimscapeSignal Analysis

I designed and built an analog circuit that amplifies an input signal and separates its frequency content using parallel active low-pass and high-pass filter branches. The circuit preserves frequencies on either side of a middle frequency band while attenuating the intervening range.

Design and validation

  • Selected component values and built the physical circuit.
  • Designed a non-inverting amplifier stage before the filtering stages.
  • Implemented parallel active low-pass and high-pass branches with buffer stages.
  • Modeled and tested circuit behavior using MATLAB and Simscape.
  • Configured cutoff frequencies near 783 Hz and 1.8 kHz to attenuate the intervening frequency band.
PROJECT 04

Ocean Adventure Play Park

CAD ModelingStructural AnalysisEngineering Design

This team design project developed an ocean-themed playground concept incorporating a lighthouse play structure, slide, monkey bars, and other play elements. My work focused on modeling and analyzing the lighthouse/playhouse component.

Individual contribution

  • Modeled the lighthouse/playhouse component within the larger playground concept.
  • Worked on structural calculations for analyzed components under specified loading assumptions.
  • The analyzed components met the project's required safety-factor criteria under those assumptions.
PROJECT 05

Automated Test & Data Acquisition System

PythonArduino UnoSerial CommunicationData Logging

I developed a Python-based test workflow for collecting voltage measurements from an Arduino Uno, checking results against configured limits, and generating test artifacts.

System capabilities

  • Collected voltage samples from an Arduino over USB serial.
  • Calculated minimum, maximum, and average voltage.
  • Compared measurements with configured acceptance limits.
  • Generated CSV data, plots, and a text summary for repeatable testing.
  • Validated a voltage divider powered by 5 V with equal resistors (R1 = R2), producing an expected midpoint of approximately 2.5 V. Recorded samples stayed within the configured 1.50–3.00 V acceptance limits.
